prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

A system, including: a power source, a multi-layer device, and an electronic controller. The multi-layer device is connected to the power source and has two sides: a viewing side and a second side opposite the viewing side. The multi-layer device permits or prevents light to pass therethrough from the second side toward the viewing side. The multi-layer device includes: a coloring layer group having a plurality of pixels, each pixel having at least three sub-pixels corresponding to different colors; and a shutter layer group having a unique subpixel shutter corresponding to each sub-pixel of the coloring layer group. The electronic controller is connected to the power source and the multi-layer device, and is adapted to control each sub-pixel shutter to selectively permit or prevent passage of an amount of light therethrough; and control each combination of sub-pixel shutter and corresponding coloring layer sub-pixel to produce pixels on the viewing side that can be any of opaque black.

Keywords: The

outputs.L1: A system comprising a power source, a multi-layer device, and an electronic controller. The multi-layer device is connected to the power source and has a viewing side and a second side opposite the viewing side. The multi-layer device is configured to selectively permit or prevent light from passing therethrough from the second side toward the viewing side. The multi-layer device comprises: a coloring-layer group having a plurality of pixels, each pixel including at least three sub-pixels corresponding to different colors; and a shutter-layer group having a unique sub-pixel shutter corresponding to each sub-pixel of the coloring-layer group. The electronic controller is connected to the power source and the multi-layer device and is configured to: control each sub-pixel shutter to selectively permit or prevent a desired amount of light from passing therethrough; and control each combination of a sub-pixel shutter and its corresponding coloring-layer sub-pixel to produce pixels on the viewing side that can be opaque black.
outputs.L2: A system comprising a power supply, a multilayer device, and an electronic controller. The multilayer device is electrically coupled to the power supply and defines a viewing surface and an opposing second surface. Light traveling from the second surface toward the viewing surface may be selectively transmitted through or blocked by the multilayer device. The device includes a color-layer assembly formed from multiple pixels, with each pixel containing at least three differently colored subpixels, and a shutter-layer assembly providing a separate subpixel shutter for every corresponding subpixel in the color-layer assembly. The electronic controller is coupled to both the power supply and the multilayer device. It is configured to independently operate each subpixel shutter to regulate or stop the amount of light passing through it and to control each paired shutter and color-layer subpixel so that pixels appearing at the viewing surface can be opaque black.
outputs.L3:
The system includes a power source, a multi-layer device, and an electronic controller. The multi-layer device has a viewing side and an opposite second side and is configured to control the passage of light from the second side toward the viewing side.

The device includes a coloring layer group comprising multiple pixels. Each pixel contains at least three sub-pixels corresponding to different colors. The device also includes a shutter layer group having a dedicated sub-pixel shutter for each corresponding sub-pixel in the coloring layer group.

The electronic controller independently operates the sub-pixel shutters to regulate the amount of light passing through each colored sub-pixel. By selectively controlling these shutters, the system produces pixels of desired colors and intensities on the viewing side, including opaque black pixels.
outputs.L4:
A powered multi-layer display includes a color-producing layer and a shutter layer arranged between a rear side and a viewing side of the display. The color-producing layer is divided into colored sub-pixels, such as red, green, and blue sub-pixels, while the shutter layer includes corresponding shutter sub-pixels that can be controlled independently. Light entering from the rear side passes through the shutter and color layers before reaching the viewer.

By adjusting each shutter sub-pixel between open, partially closed, and closed states, the display regulates the amount of light transmitted through the associated colored sub-pixel. When a shutter sub-pixel is open, light passes through the selected color sub-pixel to produce the desired visible color and brightness. When the shutter is closed, the transmitted light is substantially blocked, allowing the corresponding display pixel to appear opaque black rather than merely darkened. Intermediate shutter settings can be used to generate different intensity levels.

Independent electronic control of the shutter sub-pixels enables precise regulation of light at the pixel or sub-pixel level. In combination with the colored sub-pixels, this architecture supports detailed image rendering, accurate color reproduction, high contrast, and sharply defined black regions across the display.

**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the smallest yet most frequently used words in the English language. It is called the definite article because it points to a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “a book” can mean any book, while “the book” refers to a particular one.

Although it is easy to overlook, “the” gives language clarity and precision. It helps readers and listeners understand exactly what is being discussed. This simple three-letter word demonstrates how even the smallest parts of language can play an essential role in communication.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe a system in formal patent language where light travels from the rear side of a multi-layer device to a viewing side through a color layer and a selectively controlled shutter layer.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a single apparatus claim for a display that has at least three differently colored sub-pixels per pixel, a unique shutter for every sub-pixel, and a controller that regulates transmitted light.
counterfactuals.output: 1. A display apparatus comprising: a plurality of pixels, each pixel comprising at least three sub-pixels configured to emit or transmit light of respective different colors; a plurality of independently controllable shutters, each sub-pixel having a respective one of the shutters arranged to control transmission of light through the sub-pixel; and a controller operatively coupled to the shutters and configured to regulate an amount of light transmitted through each sub-pixel by controlling the respective shutter.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the following invention concept into a patent claim: a powered electronic display combines a pixelated coloring layer with a matching pixelated shutter layer so each color sub-pixel can be independently opened or blocked to create colors, including opaque black.
counterfactuals.output:
1. **A powered electronic display comprising:**  
   
   a pixelated coloring layer comprising a plurality of color sub-pixels arranged in pixel groups, each color sub-pixel configured to impart a respective color to light passing therethrough;  
   
   a pixelated shutter layer comprising a plurality of electrically controllable shutter elements, each shutter element being optically aligned with a corresponding one of the color sub-pixels and independently switchable between an open state that permits light to pass through the corresponding color sub-pixel and a closed state that blocks the light; and  
   
   a controller configured to independently control the shutter elements to selectively expose one or more color sub-pixels of each pixel group to produce a displayed color, and to close the shutter elements corresponding to all color sub-pixels of a pixel group to cause the pixel group to display a substantially opaque black state.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a concise claim describing a controller-operated, multi-layer light-modulating device with opposite viewing and rear sides, corresponding color and shutter sub-pixels, and selective light transmission from the rear toward the viewer.
counterfactuals.output: 1. A light-modulating device comprising: a plurality of layers disposed between opposite viewing and rear sides, including an array of color sub-pixels and an array of shutter sub-pixels corresponding to the color sub-pixels; and a controller configured to operate the shutter sub-pixels to selectively transmit light from the rear side through respective color sub-pixels toward the viewing side.
